anita: Quick brainstorm: HW partner asked for a marketplace private-offer that bundles reserved GPU commit + appliance purchase rebate + SI onboarding credits. They want a mechanism to protect their margin but make the offer simple for customers. Ideas?

marco: two-layer idea: 1) commit ladder for Redwood consumption (monthly commit bands) 2) separate HW rebate schedule paid after quarter close. keep limits so combined discount never exceeds a set cap.

liz: Finance guardrails: total effective stack <= 28% off list for most deals; strategic exceptions up to 35% with VP approval. also recommend a 2-yr minimum renewal smoothing: renewal invoice can't drop below 65% of prior-year ARR unless exec-signed.

tom: Ops note: marketplace private offers can be messy with chargebacks. prefer we issue a single consolidated invoice that shows Redwood commit + HW rebate as a separate post-invoice credit memo with clear partner invoice reference. reduces disputes.

celeste: Field/partners: partners want a visible rebate cadence (monthly vs quarterly). monthly cashflow helps them. can we do quarterly reconciliations but provide monthly accrual statements?

marco: yes, monthly accrual + quarterly settlement is doable. we just need ledger entries and partner payout workflows. billing team involvement required.

anita: Product thought: expose a "commit_bridge" SKU that customers buy once to activate the private-offer. It maps to: reserved GPU units + entitlement tokens for appliance rebate redemption + SI onboarding voucher. That makes it one-click for procurement.

liz: Legal flag: avoid tying HW purchase to Redwood commit for regulated customers in EU/GOV. need an opt-out clause for "non-tied procurement" and alternative rebate pathway (post-sale rebate via partner invoice).

partner-bot: Uploaded draft contract addenda and rebate template: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/mp-escrow-rebate-templates (view) :white_check_mark:

marco: On renewal mechanics: propose a laddered conversion credit if customer increases commit band at renewal: credit = min(8% of additional committed ARR, $50k). also offer a one-time consumption smoothing credit for first-year overages equal to 5% of committed spend applied monthly.

liz: Consumption smoothing ok but requires anti-abuse: cap smoothing to 20% of monthly committed baseline and track spike patterns.

anita: How do we handle SI services counting toward conversion vs discount? propose: PS booked via partner invoice can be earmarked (customer opt-in) and count toward conversion credit but excluded from discount cap. requires SI to provide signed SOW and invoice.

celeste: Partners liked the earmark idea. they'll need a short seller playbook showing how to document PS to count. I'll draft.

tom: Marketplace constraint: some marketplaces (vendor X) disallow discounts on marketplace SKUs; in that case we implement rebate via off-market partner invoice. Need mapping table per marketplace.

marco: Implementation items: a) commit_bridge SKU in catalog + metadata field vendor_marketplace, b) billing flag "rebate_settlement=offchain|marketplace", c) telemetry tag "commit_traffic=true" so we can measure utilization.

anita: Quick example offer for sales to pitch: 

```
Offer: Mid-Market Commit Bundle (12mo)
- Redwood reserved commit: 200k tokens/mo baseline
- HW rebate: 6% of hardware list price paid quarterly (settlement)
- SI credit: $30k SOW-verified conversion credit applied at renewal
- Combined effective discount <=28%
- Monthly smoothing: first-year overages averaged (5% buffer) with 20% cap
- Renewal floor: 65% of prior ARR unless exec exception
```

celeste: Sounds tangible. Sales will want a one-page checklist for procurement & partner procurement teams.

liz: Action: I'll work with finance to produce a model showing ARR impact and worst-case discount sensitivity. ETA Wed COB.

marco: I'll scope billing changes and estimate effort (invoice templates, accruals). ETA next Tue.

tom: Legal will prepare a marketplace-safe addendum and an opt-out clause for regulated customers. ETA Fri next week.

anita: I'll run a short pilot with 1 HW partner (appliance vendor) + 2 mid-market customers. Target kickoff in 2 weeks.

partner-bot: Pilot kickoff calendar invite created: https://redwood.internal/cal/MP-Pilot-2812349999 :bell:  

anita: Great. Thanks all. Keeping thread to record decisions. Ping me if you want to join pilot. :rocket:
